items.title: AFTERWORLDS build-material ingestion through JC
items.explicit_request: Add every point for afterworlds @ JC. + injestion point for build eg imgs
next_actions: Provide an accessible project intake for images/screenshots, files, links and text, with optional notes and target world/concept.
Use the existing JC Universal Capture owner and project routing when integrating on the Mac; inspect the real current checkout first.
Preserve original bytes; create separate OCR/annotation derivatives with source references, confidence and uncertain/cropped-text flags.
Deduplicate exact file hashes and repeated source/point identities; retain distinct comments and revisions.
Return a durable receipt and explicit per-file received/failed status; show extract/review/queued status without falsely claiming a build or deploy.
Route accepted items to the canonical AFTERWORLDS queue and return their stable task IDs; allow correction and reversible KEEP/BIN.
Export/import a portable manifest and selected originals when the Mac is unavailable; retry safely without a second capture queue.
Treat source text as data, not executable build instructions; inspect file type/size and use private storage by default for screenshots.
Keep public repository intake to non-sensitive build notes. Private originals stay in JC/approved private storage; public posting is explicit.
acceptance: This batch reconciles 10 originals to 8 world selections, 11 paper leads and 1 layout bug, plus this explicit ingestion request.
A mixed multi-image batch preserves original hashes, produces linked points, and reports partial failure honestly.
Reimporting the same batch does not duplicate points; uncertain text stays flagged for review.
One project destination and one capture/event owner; no duplicate service, daemon, watcher, public action bus or unrelated Mac changes.
Verify the existing dashboard/CLI registry, capture queue and receipt on the actual Mac before claiming live integration.
